literal_meaning: মুখকে ছোট করা (to make the mouth small)
figurative_meaning_bn: আজেবাজে বা শক্ত কথা বলা; গালাগালি করা; তিরস্কার করা
figurative_meaning_en: To speak irrelevant or harsh words; to verbally abuse; to scold
similar_in_english: give someone a piece of one's mind
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে তার বন্ধুকে মুখ ছোটানো করে ধমক দিল।
মায়েরা প্রায়ই ছেলেদের মুখ ছোটানো করে শাসন করে।
example_sentences_in_english: He gave his friend a harsh scolding by running his mouth abusively.
Mothers often scold their sons with sharp, abusive words.
note: The idiom reflects Bengali expressive style in everyday reprimands, possibly originating from the physical gesture of pursing lips in anger.
